property_summary: For any input amount, calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) on a fresh contract (with initial betLimit = 0) results in betLimit == amount (the reference overwrites the limit); the mutant that increments instead will violate this for some amount when initial betLimit != 0 — we use two sequential calls with fuzzed amounts to expose the difference: after AdjustBetAmounts(a) then AdjustBetAmounts(b), the reference always has betLimit == b, while the mutant has betLimit == a + b for some fuzzed a,b.
change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that increments the current betLimit by the provided amount.
